title: Plans for Skyscraping 200 University Avenue Addition Advance
summary: GWL Realty Advisors have tweaked their plans for a skyscraping addition of new residential floors above an existing Mid-Century Modern office building at 200 University Avenue in Downtown Toronto. Designed by KPMB Architects, the addition takes the building to 193m in height with a count of 54 storeys. While the same height as the most recent previous version, one more floor is now counted as what was strictly a mechanical penthouse before, is now now shared with four more suites.
